title.zh: 爱柚薇 · 三蓄合轴与补羽
title.en: Alice / Yuzuha / Vivian · charged overlap and feather cycling

summary.zh: 柚叶给增益并快支接薇，薇浮游切出补护羽；爱丽丝三蓄期间按需安排辅助准备。
summary.en: Yuzuha buffs and assists into Vivian; Vivian switches from floating to refill Guard Feathers. Use Alice’s fully started charge for needed teammate setup.

conditions.zh: 循环站位爱丽丝→柚叶→薇薇安，旋转等价；柚叶下一位必须是薇。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Alice → Yuzuha → Vivian; rotations are equivalent. Vivian must occupy Yuzuha’s next slot.

conditions.zh: 采用2.1作者教学方法交叉固定3.3技能；三蓄是否适合切出取决于实际积蓄与辅助需求。
conditions.en: Uses authored 2.1 methods cross-checked against fixed 3.3 skills. Whether to switch during the charge depends on actual buildup and support needs.

conditions.zh: 不把本轴当作固定双三蓄保证；异常、护羽、能量、命中与CD都按实际情况检查。
conditions.en: This does not guarantee two full charges per window. Check actual Anomalies, feathers, energy, hits and cooldowns.

conditions.zh: 只继承已交叉核对的招式方法，不继承旧攻略的伤害排名、最高分或固定耗时结论。
conditions.en: Only cross-checked action methods are retained, not old damage rankings, score claims or fixed-duration conclusions.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 爱柚薇与三蓄合轴（2.1）
label.en: Little Orange · Alice/Yuzuha/Vivian and charged overlap (2.1)

objective.zh: 先建立增益与护羽，再兑现开场三格剑仪。
objective.en: Establish buffs and Guard Feathers, then spend the opening three Etiquette bars.

prep.zh: 爱丽丝额外能力已触发才有开场300剑仪；薇开场飞羽与护羽是不同资源，不重复领取开局赠送。
prep.en: Alice’s active Additional Ability grants the opening 300 Etiquette. Vivian’s opening Flight/Guard Feathers are distinct; opening grants do not repeat.

title.zh: 柚叶EX命中，上增益并触发薇快支
title.en: Yuzuha EX hit: apply buffs and prompt Vivian’s assist

trigger.zh: 能量足够，且狸之愿／甜度或薇的补羽需要刷新；薇是柚叶的下一位。
trigger.en: Enough energy and a refresh of Tanuki Wish/Sugar or Vivian’s feathers is needed. Vivian occupies Yuzuha’s next slot.

complete.zh: 重击实际命中确认甜蜜惊吓与狸之愿；出现薇薇安提示才接快支。
complete.en: Confirm Sweet Scare/Tanuki Wish from the actual hit; use Quick Assist only when Vivian’s prompt appears.

reason.zh: 作者把柚叶排在薇前，利用快支补羽与以太配合；一次出招不保证命中或触发所有队伍效果。
reason.en: The author places Yuzuha before Vivian for assist-based feather setup and Ether coordination. Casting alone does not prove a hit or every team effect.

fallback.zh: 缺能量或增益无需刷新则跳过；没有提示不能强行按成薇快支。
fallback.en: Skip if energy is lacking or no refresh is needed. Without the prompt, do not label a switch as Vivian’s Quick Assist.

signal.zh: 柚叶EX命中出现提示，快支接下一位薇。
signal.en: After Yuzuha’s EX hits and prompts, Quick Assist into next-slot Vivian.

title.zh: 薇通过快支入场，准备浮游
title.en: Vivian enters through Quick Assist and prepares Fluttering Frock

input.zh: 按快支提示接手；已有飞羽时可在招式期间长按普攻进入浮游
input.en: Respond to Quick Assist; with Flight Feathers, hold Basic during the move to enter Fluttering Frock

trigger.zh: 柚叶确实触发了薇快支；需要补护羽。速浮游分支还要求实际持有飞羽。
trigger.en: Yuzuha actually prompted Vivian’s assist and Guard Feathers need replenishing. The immediate floating branch also needs actual Flight Feathers.

complete.zh: 确认进入裙裾浮游，再决定下一步切出；飞羽不是护羽，两者不能混用。
complete.en: Confirm Fluttering Frock before the next switch; Flight and Guard Feathers are distinct resources.

reason.zh: 快支本身进入淑女礼仪；已有飞羽才可按住普攻直接浮游，不将快支视为无条件满羽。
reason.en: Quick Assist enters Noblewoman; direct floating by held Basic needs existing Flight Feathers, rather than granting a free full refill.

fallback.zh: 无飞羽时先用淑女礼仪舞步实际命中，或能量足够的EX获取飞羽，再确认浮游；护羽已满可跳过补充。
fallback.en: Without Flight Feathers, land Noblewoman Waltz or use an available EX to gain them, then verify floating. Skip replenishment if Guard Feathers are already full.

title.zh: 浮游中切回爱丽丝，薇自动悬落
title.en: Switch from Fluttering Frock to Alice; Vivian falls automatically

input.zh: 确认裙裾浮游后普通切爱丽丝
input.en: Switch normally to Alice after confirming Fluttering Frock

trigger.zh: 实际处于裙裾浮游、需要转换飞羽；如果爱丽丝仍在三蓄续招，先确认其终结一击已结算。
trigger.en: Actually in Fluttering Frock and needing to convert Flight Feathers. If Alice’s charged attack is still ongoing, first confirm its finishing hit resolved.

complete.zh: 薇自动悬落并按实际资源获得护羽；观察护羽上限，别把溢出也算成库存。
complete.en: Vivian automatically performs Suspension and gains Guard Feathers according to actual resources; respect the cap rather than counting overflow.

reason.zh: 固定技能明确支持浮游状态切人自动悬落，因此可将实际续招画到下一位接战事件。
reason.en: The fixed skill explicitly supports automatic Suspension when switching from Fluttering Frock, so its actual continuation can accompany the next entrant.

fallback.zh: 未浮游时不要直接当作自动悬落；不需要补羽就完成当前动作后正常交回爱丽丝。
fallback.en: Do not assume automatic Suspension outside Fluttering Frock. If no feather refill is needed, finish the current action and return normally to Alice.

signal.zh: 浮游成立后普通切爱；返回前确认上一轮爱丽丝终结一击已结算。
signal.en: Switch normally to Alice from Fluttering Frock; first confirm Alice’s preceding finishing hit resolved.

title.zh: 三格长按普攻，兑现极性强击
title.en: Hold Basic with three bars to cash out Polarity Assault

input.zh: 持有三格剑仪时持续长按普攻，等三段消耗完成
input.en: With three bars of Etiquette, keep holding Basic until all three charging stages are consumed

trigger.zh: 实际剑仪300（三格）；目标可命中。三段终结一击命中才有极性强击，不能将一、二蓄等同。
trigger.en: An actual 300 Etiquette (three bars) and a hittable target. Polarity Assault requires the three-stage finishing hit; lower charge levels are different.

complete.zh: 确认终结一击与极性强击结算；需要由本招打普通强击时保留前台至关键命中。
complete.en: Confirm the finishing hit and Polarity Assault. If this move must also deliver ordinary Assault, remain on field through its required hit.

reason.zh: 作者指出三段蓄力后消失是可切信号，但早切和过早切回都会改变执行；本方案不假定后台额外爆普通强击。
reason.en: The author identifies disappearance after full charge as a handoff cue. Premature departure/return can alter execution; this plan does not assume an extra off-field ordinary Assault.

fallback.zh: 剑仪不足先补；三段未完成不要松开。若不需要队友准备，留前台完成后再常规切人。
fallback.en: Build Etiquette if short and do not release before three stages. If teammates need no setup, finish on field before switching normally.

objective.zh: 爱丽丝攒满三格；仅辅助有事可做时，把三蓄续招用于换人准备。
objective.en: Build Alice’s three bars; overlap the fully started charge only when teammates have useful setup.

prep.zh: 如果柚叶增益和薇护羽都够，可省略后面的补充步骤，留爱丽丝继续输出。
prep.en: Skip the later refresh steps when Yuzuha’s buffs and Vivian’s Guard Feathers already suffice; keep Alice dealing damage.

prep.zh: 返回爱丽丝前必须确认上一轮极性强击已命中结算；不按固定秒表推定。
prep.en: Before returning to Alice, confirm the preceding Polarity Assault actually landed; do not infer it from a fixed timer.

title.zh: 用强化突刺补剑仪，按真实攻击闪避
title.en: Build Blade Etiquette with EX; dodge actual attacks

input.zh: 能量足够时，向前方向＋强化特殊技
input.en: With enough energy, forward input + EX Special

trigger.zh: 剑仪需要补充、能量足够、目标可命中；不要满剑仪仍重复补资源。
trigger.en: Blade Etiquette needs replenishment, energy is sufficient, and the target is hittable. Avoid refilling an already full gauge.

complete.zh: 招式发动回复10剑仪；物理积蓄按实际命中核对，极限闪避只在实际触发时计对应效果。
complete.en: Activation restores 10 Blade Etiquette. Check actual hits for Physical buildup and credit Perfect Dodge effects only when triggered.

reason.zh: 作者将EX作为剑仪和物理异常积蓄手段；薇后台护羽足够且该EX命中时才能触发落羽生花。
reason.en: The author uses EX for Etiquette and Physical buildup. Off-field Vivian requires a Guard Feather and an actual EX hit for Featherbloom.

fallback.zh: 缺能量可用当前可用普攻、闪反或支援补资源；无羽就不要把薇异放算作必然发生。
fallback.en: Use available Basics, Dodge Counters or Assists if energy is lacking; do not assume Vivian’s Abloom without feathers.

label.zh: 落羽生花 · 有护羽且队友EX实际命中时
label.en: Featherbloom · with a Guard Feather and an actual allied EX hit

title.zh: 补剑仪与物理积蓄，核对强化第五段
title.en: Build Etiquette/Physical buildup; verify enhanced hit five

input.zh: 使用当前可用的普攻衔接
input.en: Use the currently available Basic follow-up

trigger.zh: 本轮剑仪尚未达到三格；强化第五段必须由爱丽丝通过积蓄触发强击后取得。
trigger.en: Etiquette is still below three bars. Enhanced hit five requires Alice to have triggered Assault through buildup.

complete.zh: 观察实际三格剑仪；满足强化条件才把第五段当强化招式。
complete.en: Read the actual three-bar gauge; treat hit five as enhanced only when its condition is satisfied.

reason.zh: 普通与强化普攻不能混算，实际资源会受到命中、异常与队友紊乱影响。
reason.en: Ordinary and enhanced Basics differ; actual resources depend on hits, Anomalies and allied Disorders.

fallback.zh: 资源够了直接进入三蓄；衔接失误则回可用普攻，不凭固定按键次数补满剑仪。
fallback.en: Proceed to the charged move when ready. On a failed follow-up, use an available Basic rather than assuming a fixed input count fills Etiquette.

title.zh: 三格长按普攻，兑现极性强击
title.en: Hold Basic with three bars to cash out Polarity Assault

complete.zh: 确认三段消耗完成并进入消失的可切信号；若选择留场，则等终结一击结算。
complete.en: Confirm all three charging stages are spent and the disappearance handoff cue is reached. If staying on field, wait for the finishing hit.

reason.zh: 作者指出三段蓄力后消失是可切信号，但早切和过早切回都会改变执行；本方案不假定后台额外爆普通强击。

fallback.zh: 剑仪不足先补；三段未完成不要松开。若不需要队友准备，留前台完成后再常规切人。
fallback.en: Build Etiquette if short and do not release before three stages. If teammates need no setup, finish on field before switching normally.

signal.zh: 确需补辅助时：三段完成、爱丽丝消失后普通切柚；否则等终结一击再切。
signal.en: When support setup is needed, switch normally to Yuzuha after all three stages and Alice’s disappearance; otherwise wait for the finishing hit.

title.en: Yuzuha EX hit: apply buffs and prompt Vivian’s assist

label.zh: 三蓄续招 · 已到可切信号且终结一击尚未结算
label.en: Charged continuation · handoff cue reached, finishing hit not yet resolved

title.en: Vivian enters through Quick Assist and prepares Fluttering Frock

objective.zh: 窗口前准备辅助，窗口内按实际资源三蓄→Q→有条件再三蓄。
objective.en: Prepare supports before the window; spend an actual full charge, ready Ultimate, then another charge only if resources suffice.

prep.zh: 前三步是窗口前刷新；增益与护羽已有覆盖时跳过，别把整个失衡期耗在辅助补课。
prep.en: The first three events are pre-window refreshes. Skip them when buffs/feathers already cover the window.

prep.zh: 三蓄资源或命中机会不足时返回常态；队友连携仅在实际提示与需要时选择，不强制全部连携。
prep.en: Return to the regular loop if charge resources or hit opportunities are lacking. Use Chains only on actual prompts and when useful; do not force the full team’s Chains.

title.zh: 三格长按普攻，兑现极性强击
title.en: Hold Basic with three bars to cash out Polarity Assault

input.zh: 持有三格剑仪时持续长按普攻，等三段消耗完成
input.en: With three bars of Etiquette, keep holding Basic until all three charging stages are consumed

trigger.zh: 实际剑仪300（三格）；目标可命中。三段终结一击命中才有极性强击，不能将一、二蓄等同。
trigger.en: An actual 300 Etiquette (three bars) and a hittable target. Polarity Assault requires the three-stage finishing hit; lower charge levels are different.

complete.zh: 确认终结一击与极性强击结算；需要由本招打普通强击时保留前台至关键命中。
complete.en: Confirm the finishing hit and Polarity Assault. If this move must also deliver ordinary Assault, remain on field through its required hit.

reason.zh: 作者指出三段蓄力后消失是可切信号，但早切和过早切回都会改变执行；本方案不假定后台额外爆普通强击。
reason.en: The author identifies disappearance after full charge as a handoff cue. Premature departure/return can alter execution; this plan does not assume an extra off-field ordinary Assault.

fallback.zh: 剑仪不足先补；三段未完成不要松开。若不需要队友准备，留前台完成后再常规切人。
fallback.en: Build Etiquette if short and do not release before three stages. If teammates need no setup, finish on field before switching normally.

title.zh: 终结技就绪时回剑仪，再判断下一次三蓄
title.en: A ready Ultimate restores Etiquette; then recheck the next charge

trigger.zh: 终结技实际就绪、目标可命中，窗口仍适合输出；查看剑仪余量，避免浪费回复。
trigger.en: Ultimate actually ready, target hittable, and a useful output window remains. Check gauge space to avoid wasting its refill.

complete.zh: 获得200剑仪后重新查看总量；仍不足300就先补，不把一次Q当作必然再次三蓄。
complete.en: After gaining 200 Etiquette, recheck the total. Build more if below 300; one Ultimate does not guarantee another full charge.

reason.zh: 本招提供资源回复；0影终结技本身不被写成必有极性强击，2影规则另列。
reason.en: This move restores resources. At M0, its own hit is not labeled a guaranteed Polarity Assault; the M2 rule is separate.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪跳过，以实际剩余剑仪回常态；不为硬塞双三蓄在窗口内空等。
fallback.en: Skip when unavailable and return to the regular loop from actual Etiquette; do not wait idle to force two full charges into a window.

title.zh: 三格长按普攻，兑现极性强击
title.en: Hold Basic with three bars to cash out Polarity Assault

input.zh: 持有三格剑仪时持续长按普攻，等三段消耗完成
input.en: With three bars of Etiquette, keep holding Basic until all three charging stages are consumed

trigger.zh: 实际剑仪300（三格）；目标可命中。三段终结一击命中才有极性强击，不能将一、二蓄等同。
trigger.en: An actual 300 Etiquette (three bars) and a hittable target. Polarity Assault requires the three-stage finishing hit; lower charge levels are different.

complete.en: Confirm the finishing hit and Polarity Assault. If this move must also deliver ordinary Assault, remain on field through its required hit.

reason.en: The author identifies disappearance after full charge as a handoff cue. Premature departure/return can alter execution; this plan does not assume an extra off-field ordinary Assault.

fallback.en: Build Etiquette if short and do not release before three stages. If teammates need no setup, finish on field before switching normally.

text.zh: 爱丽丝1影的极性强击回25剑仪，下一轮仍按实际总量判断，不固定减少一套操作。
text.en: Alice M1 restores 25 Etiquette on Polarity Assault; read the actual next total rather than deleting a fixed string.

text.zh: 爱丽丝2影终结一击也可触发极性强击；开局1000喧响不等于终结技已经就绪。
text.en: Alice M2 adds Polarity Assault to the Ultimate’s finishing hit; its opening 1000 Decibels do not mean the Ultimate is ready.

text.zh: 柚叶1影只在开场补30能量，不在每轮刷新；仍检查本次EX是否可用。
text.en: Yuzuha M1’s opening 30 energy does not repeat each loop; still check current EX availability.

text.zh: 柚叶2影对未失衡目标的指定重击可强制连携，受20秒间隔限制；出现时按实际提示处理，不自动假定敌人失衡。
text.en: Yuzuha M2 can force a Chain from qualifying heavy hits on a non-Stunned enemy, subject to a 20-second limit; respond to the prompt without assuming the enemy is Stunned.

text.zh: 薇4影开场已有5护羽，可减少不必要的补羽；不要把飞羽转化溢出算作更多库存。
text.en: Vivian M4 starts with five Guard Feathers, allowing unnecessary refills to be skipped; do not count conversion overflow as stored resources.

text.zh: 薇6影悬落会消耗护羽触发特殊异放；结束后重新检查护羽，不能沿用动作前的库存。
text.en: Vivian M6’s Suspension spends Guard Feathers for a special Abloom; recheck the resulting stock instead of carrying over its pre-move value.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柚叶EX命中，上增益并触发薇快支: 强化特殊技命中，等入场提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.薇通过快支入场，准备浮游: 按快支入场，需要浮游再长按普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.三格长按普攻，兑现极性强击: 满三格剑仪时长按普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.用强化突刺补剑仪，按真实攻击闪避: 向前按强化特殊技补剑仪

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.强化特殊技：小心蛀牙: 能量足够时按强化特殊技；命中后，等指定队友的入场提示。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按快支提示接手；已有飞羽时可在招式期间长按普攻进入浮游: 看到薇薇安的快速支援提示后按支援键。已有飞羽、需要浮游时，在支援动作中长按普攻。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.持有三格剑仪时持续长按普攻，等三段消耗完成: 剑仪满三格时持续长按普攻，等三段蓄力完成。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足够时，向前方向＋强化特殊技: 能量足够时向前输入方向，同时按强化特殊技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.使用当前可用的普攻衔接: 点按普攻积攒剑仪；到第五段时，看强化攻击是否实际发动。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.终结技：星芒终章: 爱丽丝的终结技就绪后按终结技，再看还差多少剑仪。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1401: 点按普攻积攒剑仪；能量足够时也可向前按强化特殊技。满三格才长按普攻打三蓄。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.141100008: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，让炸弹命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.141100015: 终结技就绪时按终结技，等命中

133100003: 手动悬落才点普攻；已浮游时直接普通切主攻可自动悬落，两条路不要重复按。
Tap Basic for a manual descent. Switching to the carry from Suspension triggers the automatic descent instead; do not do both.
133100014: 先接实际入场提示。只有在快支中、已有飞羽且需要进浮游，才额外长按普攻；不是入场前置。
Respond to the actual entry prompt. Hold Basic during Quick Assist only if you have Flight Feathers and want Suspension; not required before entry.
140100001: 普攻是本步积剑仪的方式，按目标资源决定何时停；要触发第五段效果才打到第五段。
Use Basics here for Sword Etiquette; stop when the resource target is reached. Hit 5 is needed only for its own effect.
140100002: 满三格时长按普攻蓄到第三阶段；这是持续按住的蓄力，不是普攻连续点三下。
At three gauges, hold Basic to charge level 3. This is a held charge, not three taps.
140100010: 终结技不用先按普攻；仅在剑仪已满、要避免溢出时，先长按普攻打完三段蓄力。
No Basic required before Ultimate. Only spend a full gauge with a charged Basic first if needed to avoid overcapping.

1331: 可以用强化特殊技补羽；走普攻入浮游路线才检查第四段和飞羽条件。两种入口不要求先后都按。
EX can supply Feathers; the Basic entry into Suspension checks hit 4 and Feathers. These are alternatives, not two mandatory inputs.
1401: 需要剑仪可用普攻积攒或有能量时用强化特殊技；满三格后才长按普攻三蓄。
Build gauge with Basics or EX with sufficient Energy. Only then, at three gauges, hold Basic for the full charge.
